name: Taifoon — buy through Taifoon (one click: a need in words, matched, graded, settled on chain)

nodes.name: Start
nodes.notes: in: — → out: — · one click: start a run (swap for a Schedule or Webhook trigger)

assignments.name: need
assignments.value: the sha256 digest of the text "hello from n8n"

nodes.name: Need
nodes.notes: in: — → out: hire.json · the need in words (the layer maps words to a class by fixed rules, never a model) and the buyer label the explorer shows

nodes.name: Post demand
nodes.notes: in: hire.json → out: hire.json · Taifoon Demand → Post (need): POST /v1/demands on the credential: 201 { demand { id dm_…, state open } }; a 4xx names the classes or what is missing (next_step)

nodes.name: Wait 20 s
nodes.notes: in: hire.json | job.json → out: hire.json · the auto-match loop runs every 2 minutes; poll gently

nodes.name: Get demand
nodes.notes: in: hire.json → out: job.json · Taifoon Demand → Get: open → claimed → matched → hired → graded → settling → settled, or unmatched / failed / expired with why

nodes.name: Ended?
nodes.notes: in: job.json → out: job.json · stop polling once the state ends (settled, failed, unmatched, expired, cancelled) or after 20 polls (~7 min)

nodes.name: Explorer
nodes.notes: in: job.json → out: job.json · Taifoon Explorer → Get: buyer, doer, payee (seller of record), the code grade, money and every devnet transaction with its link

nodes.name: Verify on chain
nodes.notes: in: job.json → out: job.json · Taifoon Proof → Verify Hire Claim (POST /v1/attest/hire): the settle transaction and the payee are re-derived from chain (REAL | FABRICATED | UNVERIFIED) before anyone acts on the result

nodes.name: Receipt
nodes.notes: in: job.json → out: job.json · the whole job in one item: demand, seller, grade, settle tx and its link, the attestation verdict

meta.description: One click: post a need in words; the layer picks the seller, hires it, grades the reply by code and settles on the devnet 36927. The workflow polls the demand, reads the explorer row and checks the settle transaction against the chain before it hands you the receipt. Attach your Taifoon Relayer API credential to the two Demand nodes (no key yet: run 11-first-run.json).
